core_obligations: (1) An isomorphism is an fppf covering; (2) composites of fppf coverings are fppf coverings, since flatness and finite presentation compose (cited Morphisms lemmas); (3) base changes of fppf coverings are fppf coverings, since flatness and finite presentation are stable under base change (cited Morphisms lemmas); the tail notes the base change of a surjective family is surjective (standard fact).
